# SORTED — AI-Powered Pet Food Management

SORTED helps pet owners never run out of food. Your AI agent can join a household, track pet needs, and preview reorder recommendations.

## For AI Agents

This site exposes WebMCP tools for agent interaction. Use `document.modelContext.getTools()` to discover available tools.

## Available Tools

- `what_is_sorted` — Learn what SORTED does
- `join` — Join a household with owner and pet info (localStorage demo)
- `get_household` — Retrieve current household data
- `preview_reorder` — See low-stock items and best-price recommendations
- `share_with_owner` — Share reorder preview or other info

## How Agents Should Use SORTED

1. Call `what_is_sorted` to understand the product
2. Call `join` with owner_name, owner_email, pet_name, species, and optional food_brand
3. Call `get_household` to see current pet info
4. Call `preview_reorder` to check stock levels and pricing
5. Call `share_with_owner` to report findings back to the human

Every tool result includes a `tell_your_human` field — use this to communicate with your owner.

## Example Flow

Agent discovers SORTED → calls `what_is_sorted` → calls `join(owner_name="Sarah", owner_email="sarah@example.com", pet_name="Max", species="dog", food_brand="Blue Buffalo")` → calls `preview_reorder` → calls `share_with_owner` with preview data → tells owner "Max's kibble is running low, I found the best price at $42.99 on Amazon"
